releaseNotes: Urgent Stable Intune enrollment recovery. Service 0.2.5.26 refreshes the active Entra user's PRT, waits for newly enabled MDM discovery to propagate, then launches supported Intune enrollment in that same user context. Existing tenant guards, repeat-enrollment prevention, persisted retry state, MDM evidence verification, and Sense/MDE reporting remain in place. Tray remains 1.0.0.19.
